intent.proves: Pages, paragraphs and grid rows carry soft-delete state.
intent.scope: schema of Page, Paragraph and GridRow

bindings.reason: Tool is scoped to one area or page; a handler must enumerate every area/page and aggregate, which mcp-count does not do. Presence of the tool alone is not a measured observation.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (TABLE_NAME = N'Page' AND COLUMN_NAME = N'PageDeleted') OR (TABLE_NAME = N'Paragraph' AND COLUMN_NAME = N'ParagraphDeleted') OR (TABLE_NAME = N'GridRow' AND COLUMN_NAME = N'GridRowDeleted')
